data.narrative: The student implemented an environment-driven configuration system where Docker images remain environment independent. They validated startup failures for incorrect configuration, verified health endpoints, and understood the security impact of configuration mistakes.

dimension_scores.observation: Built and verified a Docker image without embedding environment files.
dimension_scores.evidence: Ran docker run --rm myservice ls -la and confirmed no .env file existed inside the image.

dimension_scores.observation: Understood external configuration injection but has limited CI/CD automation experience.
dimension_scores.evidence: Used environment variables to keep deployment configuration separate from application code.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented health endpoints but has not yet added metrics or alerting.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified GET /live and GET /ready endpoints successfully.

dimension_scores.observation: Tested configuration failures instead of only validating successful startup.
dimension_scores.evidence: Provided invalid DB_HOST value and confirmed application failed during startup.

dimension_scores.observation: Has basic dependency awareness but needs more production failure handling patterns.
dimension_scores.evidence: Validated database configuration failure behavior during startup.

dimension_scores.observation: Captured commands and evidence during verification.
dimension_scores.evidence: Recorded Docker and curl verification outputs.

strengths: Understands environment separation and avoids hardcoded infrastructure values.
Validated failure scenarios instead of only testing the happy path.
growth_areas: Gain more experience with CI/CD automation and deployment strategies.
Learn production observability concepts such as metrics and alerting.
data.recommendation: In the next module, focus on adding structured logging, metrics, and production monitoring practices.

public_evidence.student_action: Added health checks and verified container does not contain environment files.
public_evidence.technical_detail: GET /live, GET /ready, docker run --rm myservice ls -la
public_evidence.proof: Health endpoints returned status ok and ready; Docker image contained no .env file.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows ability to build deployable services with environment isolation.
